title: Release Train: Weekly Launch Readiness Notes - 2026-05-29
content:
Context:
Quick notes for the weekly release train / launch-readiness sync. Target release window: 2026-06-02 to 2026-06-04 (canary -> ramp). This doc is my prep + live notes for the 1:1/weekly with eng/product/SRE leads.

Attendees (expected):
- Samir Patel (release lead)
- Maya Singh (product PM)
- Noah Kim (QA lead)
- Elena Ruiz (infra/SRE)
- Avery Brooks (docs/comms)
- optional: Arjun Mehta (security), Priya Kapoor (sales ops)

Agenda draft:
1) Quick rollup of what’s green/red since last week (2-3m each)
2) Go/No-Go checklist review (owner callouts)
3) Open blockers & mitigation plans (call for decisions)
4) Canary plan & metrics for success (SLOs + thresholds)
5) Comm plan and cutover timing (who triggers)
6) Post-launch monitoring & rollback triggers
7) Action items / owners (capture live)

Go / No-Go checklist (status = OK | At Risk | Blocked)
- Release artifacts built + images pushed (owner: release-ci) - OK
- E2E smoke tests (prod-like) passing on canary infra (owner: Noah Kim) - At Risk (2 flaky tests in auth flow)
- Security review + pen test signoff (owner: Arjun Mehta) - OK (exceptions tracked: CSP header missing on admin UI, low severity)
- Infra capacity validated for 2x expected load (owner: Elena Ruiz) - OK (autoscale policy tested, but need one more dry run)
- DB migrations reviewed + reversible plan (owner: Eng-DB) - OK
- Runbook updated + runbook owner assigned (owner: Samir Patel / Avery Brooks) - In Progress (docs updated; need test run)
- Feature flags + gradual rollout configured (owner: Maya Singh) - OK
- Observability dashboards and alerting in place (owner: Elena Ruiz) - At Risk (missing alert on prefix-cache-evictions)
- Customer comms prepared + legal reviewed (owner: Avery Brooks) - In Progress

Open blockers and notes:
- Auth smoke tests failing intermittently: failing step is token refresh TTL race. Noah investigating flaky test harness vs real bug. If real bug, hotfix required pre-canary. (Priority: high)
- Prefix-cache eviction alert missing: could miss noisy regression that increases cost. Elena to add alert and test by 2026-05-30 EOD. (Priority: high)
- Release runbook dry-run not completed: need 1 dry-run with on-call and shift lead to validate manual steps. Tentative: 2026-06-01 morning.
- Communications: legal flagged phrasing in customer notice about data residency. Avery to loop Legal + Customer Success. (Blocked on Legal clarity)

Canary plan (high level):
- Canary region: us-west-2 (small pool)
- Canary cohort: internal + 5 pilot customers (controlled)
- Canary duration: 4 hours initially, review metrics at 1h and 4h
- Success metrics: 99.9% request success, median p95 latency < 220ms, error budget burn < 5% in window, no increase in cache eviction rate > 2x baseline
- Rollforward: if canary success, ramp to 10% traffic -> 50% over 6h; if any critical failures, rollback to previous model/variant and pause launch.

Monitoring & rollback triggers:
- Immediate rollback if: >1% 5xxs sustained for 5m OR critical auth error rate spike >0.5% OR any data-loss / corruption alert.
- Auto-alerts: canary dashboard + paging to platform oncall. Elena to ensure runbook paging steps are verified.

Communications plan:
- Pre-launch (T-24h): customer email draft + support playbook - owner: Avery Brooks (due 2026-06-01 18:00 PT)
- Launch day: Slack channel #release-rt-live for comms + operations, SRE oncall pinned
- Post-launch summary + incident notes within 24h - owner: Samir Patel

Action items (live):
- Noah: investigate auth smoke test flaky failure; root cause by 2026-05-30 EOD; escalate if requires code fix. (Status: In progress)
- Elena: add prefix-cache-evictions alert + test paging; complete by 2026-05-30 EOD. (Status: In progress)
- Avery: finalize customer comms and legal signoff; need final copy by 2026-06-01 18:00. (Status: Waiting on Legal)
- Samir: schedule runbook dry-run with oncall (target 2026-06-01 09:00) and share checklist. (Status: TODO)
- Maya: confirm feature-flag gating + rollback toggles are tested end-to-end by 2026-05-31. (Status: TODO)
- Eng-DB (owner: Priya/Kevin): verify migration backout works on staging by 2026-05-30. (Status: TODO)

Decisions needed in meeting:
- If auth smoke failure is test-only (no code issue), proceed with canary and monitor closely - decision: allow canary with tighter auth alerts? (Decision maker: Noah + Samir)
- Do we require one full dry-run before canary? Tradeoff: delay by 24h vs risk on-call unfamiliarity.

Notes to self / talking points:
- Emphasize staged rollout and explicit rollback gates - remove ambiguity on who hits rollback (owner is Samir or SRE lead if paging triggered).
- Ask Legal for quick turnaround on comms phrasing - provide suggested language to speed review.
- Push for one more infra dry-run even if it shifts canary by 24h - prefer safe.

Follow-up / next sync:
- Quick check-in tomorrow 2026-05-30 10:00 PT to confirm blockers cleared.
- Full go/no-go meeting 2026-06-01 11:00 PT (final decision).

Misc scratch notes (concrete links):
- Canary dashboard: dash id: dash-release-2026-canary (Elena)
- Runbook PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/release-runbook/pull/78
- Related Jira: JIRA-RT-456 (master epic), JIRA-AUTH-992 (flaky test)

END - quick and messy: capture items above during meeting and push to JIRA as tasks.
